F012: For D018=.500 SHCS, the supplied ASME B18.3 normal-fit chart gives clearance drill .531 and counterbore diameter .812. The explicitly printed D017 overrides the chart's default counterbore depth. Section A-A shows the passage ending in the transverse opening; drilling to its axial midpoint overshoots the right web without drilling the left web.

F013: Use the standard 5/16 inch (.3125) tap drill for D015=.375, 16-TPI UNC. Model the specified threaded depth as a flat-bottom nominal bore with cosmetic threads; no unprinted drill-point or extra bottom allowance is added. The end view shows symmetric offsets about both axis centerlines.
F014: Both rows and both columns are mirror images about the end-view centerlines; pitches are twice the dimensioned offsets.
